items.title: Netflix Just Hit a 52-Week Low. Where’s the Bottom?
items.summary: Netflix has shed nearly half its value from the peak, and ad cuts and a massive Warner Bros. bet are fueling the fear. Yet record buybacks and fat margins tell a different story, so which signal should investors trust?

items.title: Netflix Is Playing a Bigger Game. Investors Should Take Notice
